evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton asserts cadence by positional authority and frames the logical necessity that supplies the governing fact.
The note-taker records the cadence as a settled decision, exercising positional authority to memorialize it.
Assigning a named owner is an exercise of positional authority over who is accountable.

mints.name: RehearsedOrNonexistent
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here claimed by equating the unrehearsed contingency with its absence, so that rehearsal becomes the proof of possession?
